info.name: ResQNet Lite
info.description: Demo client for ResQNet Lite. Start the gateway first: kubectl -n resqnet port-forward svc/api-gateway 8080:8080. Run folders 0-5 in order (Collection Runner); folder 6 is the resilience demo and needs kubectl scale commands between its requests. Every request has status-code tests.

item.name: 0 - Health
item.description: The gateway answers without a token.

item.name: 1 - Security
item.description: Authentication is checked at the gateway: the request never reaches a service.

item.name: 2 - Auth
item.description: Register, login (stores userToken / adminToken) and who-am-I.

exec: // a fresh user name for every run, so the request never fails with 409

item.name: 3 - Incidents
item.description: Report incidents (synchronous call to responder-service) and manage them as admin.

item.name: Admin: dispatch (409 if the incident is not PENDING)

request.description: For the real dispatch demo use folder 6 (responder-service scaled to 0).

exec: pm.test('200 when it was PENDING, otherwise 409 INVALID_STATE', () => pm.expect([200, 409]).to.include(pm.response.code));

item.name: Admin: resolve (409 if the incident is not ASSIGNED)

exec: pm.test('200 RESOLVED, or 409 when it was still PENDING', () => pm.expect([200, 409]).to.include(pm.response.code));
pm.test('at least one notification (event arrived)', () => pm.expect(list.length).to.be.above(0));

item.name: Mark the newest notification as read
5 - Responders
item.description: Read-only catalogue (admin create/offline endpoints are not implemented).

exec: pm.test('all AMBULANCE and AVAILABLE', () => pm.response.json().forEach(r => { pm.expect(r.type).to.eql('AMBULANCE'); pm.expect(r.status).to.eql('AVAILABLE'); }));

item.name: 6 - Resilience demo
item.description: Run these in order DURING the demo. Before request 1: kubectl -n resqnet scale deploy/responder-service --replicas=0 . Before request 3: kubectl -n resqnet scale deploy/responder-service --replicas=1 and wait until the pod is Ready (about 30 s). Not part of an automatic run (it needs kubectl).

item.name: 1. Report incident while responder-service is DOWN (expect PENDING)
3. Admin: dispatch the pending incident after scaling back to 1 (expect ASSIGNED)
